setting-out-talking-to-pirate-pete.speaker: Pirate Pete
setting-out-talking-to-pirate-pete.text: Yeah, I do, as a matter of fact!

setting-out-talking-to-pirate-pete.speaker: Pirate Pete
setting-out-talking-to-pirate-pete.text: I am a poor, dispossessed nobleman, forced by circumstance to lurk in the middle of nowhere, soliciting help from passers-by.

setting-out-talking-to-pirate-pete.speaker: Pirate Pete
setting-out-talking-to-pirate-pete.text: You see, my fiendish half-brother has seized my estates and forced me into exile.

setting-out-talking-to-pirate-pete.speaker: Pirate Pete
setting-out-talking-to-pirate-pete.text: The simple lemon farmers suffer under his tyrannous yoke, and only a brave adventurer can lift his iron boot from the neck of the poor.

setting-out-talking-to-pirate-pete.speaker: Pirate Pete
setting-out-talking-to-pirate-pete.text: To reclaim my lands I will need to have my family sword returned to me so that I may present it as proof of my rulership.

setting-out-talking-to-pirate-pete.speaker: Pirate Pete
setting-out-talking-to-pirate-pete.text: Will you help me find my family sword?
If the player has one or more levels less than the requirement:

steps.text: Before starting this quest, be aware that one or more of your skill levels are lower than what is required to fully complete it.

options.text: Yes!

steps.player: Yes! Your uncorroborated sob story has touched my heart. When do we set off?

steps.speaker: Pirate Pete
steps.text: You'll help! Wonderful!

steps.speaker: Pirate Pete
steps.text: But, alas, my half brother has a powerful ally, the mighty demon...

steps.speaker: Pirate Pete
steps.text: Err...

steps.speaker: Pirate Pete
steps.text: Err...Barrelor!

steps.player: Barrelor?

steps.speaker: Pirate Pete
steps.text: That's what I said!

steps.speaker: Pirate Pete
steps.text: Barrelor is an awesome opponent, and to reclaim my family sword you will need to defeat him, for he guards it within the deadly Trapped Pit of Barrelor.

options.text: Of course, I fear no demon!

steps.player: Of course, I fear no demon!

steps.speaker: Pirate Pete
steps.text: Atta [boy/girl]!

steps.speaker: Pirate Pete
steps.text: When I am reinstated in my rightful place, I will not be a very wealthy man, as my half-brother has squandered my family fortune.

steps.speaker: Pirate Pete
steps.text: However, I will gladly give you every bent penny of what is left, and starve in the gutter with my many, many adorable children, if you say you will help me.

options.text: Nonsense! Keep the money!

steps.player: Nonsense! Keep the money! I will dispose of this evil half-brother of yours and leave you what little money is left to feed your family.

steps.speaker: Pirate Pete
steps.text: Wonderful! Just pick up your diversion and we'll leave!

steps.player: What diversion?

steps.text: Pirate Pete catches the player off guard and knocks them out with a bottle.

steps.player: Ow!

steps.text: (Cutscene 1 begins.)

options.text: Great, I'll take the cash in used coins please.

steps.player: Great, I'll take the cash in used coins please.

steps.speaker: Pirate Pete
steps.text: Er...

steps.speaker: Pirate Pete
steps.text: Look, I think I'll wait here for someone a little more... you know...

steps.speaker: Pirate Pete
steps.text: ...heroic.

options.text: Not a chance, this sounds too dangerous.

steps.player: Not a chance, this sounds too dangerous.

steps.speaker: Pirate Pete
steps.text: Look, I think I'll wait here for someone a little more... you know...

steps.speaker: Pirate Pete
steps.text: ...heroic.

options.text: No.

steps.speaker: Pirate Pete
steps.text: Look, I think I'll wait here for someone a little more... you know...

steps.speaker: Pirate Pete
steps.text: ...heroic.

steps.player: Had any luck finding someone to slay the demon?

steps.speaker: Pirate Pete
steps.text: What?

steps.speaker: Pirate Pete
steps.text: Oh! Yes! The demon, with the oppression and stuff!

steps.speaker: Pirate Pete
steps.text: No, not yet. Why?

options.text: Because I came to offer to help.

steps.speaker: Pirate Pete
steps.text: That's the spirit!

setting-out-cutscene-1.speaker: Pirate Pete
setting-out-cutscene-1.text: I found us a hero down by the docks!

setting-out-cutscene-1.speaker: Captain Braindeath
setting-out-cutscene-1.text: Be they heroic, brave and true?

setting-out-cutscene-1.speaker: Pirate Pete
setting-out-cutscene-1.text: Aye! They also be gullible, tied up and unconscious!

setting-out-cutscene-1.speaker: Pirate Pete
setting-out-cutscene-1.text: They were willing to help out some random stranger with a good enough sob story, so I smacked them with a bottle and rowed them over.

setting-out-cutscene-1.speaker: Captain Braindeath
setting-out-cutscene-1.text: Brilliant! The island's location will remain a secret!

setting-out-cutscene-1.speaker: Captain Braindeath
setting-out-cutscene-1.text: We may make it through this yet...

setting-out-meeting-captain-braindeath.speaker: Captain Braindeath
setting-out-meeting-captain-braindeath.text: Are ye alright, [lad/lass]?

setting-out-meeting-captain-braindeath.player: It feels like someone has smacked me one with a bottle...

setting-out-meeting-captain-braindeath.speaker: Captain Braindeath
setting-out-meeting-captain-braindeath.text: Arr... Those devils gave ye a nasty knock when ye came to aid us.

setting-out-meeting-captain-braindeath.speaker: Captain Braindeath
setting-out-meeting-captain-braindeath.text: But now yer here we'll run those evil brain-eatin' dogs off the island fer good!

setting-out-meeting-captain-braindeath.player: What? What is going on here?
I can't seem to remember anything beyond chatting to a man at the docks.

setting-out-meeting-captain-braindeath.speaker: Captain Braindeath
setting-out-meeting-captain-braindeath.text: Arr. Well, [lad/lass], that would be Pete, one of my men.

setting-out-meeting-captain-braindeath.speaker: Captain Braindeath
setting-out-meeting-captain-braindeath.text: He's been out lookin' fer heroes like yerself to aid us in our peril.

setting-out-meeting-captain-braindeath.player: Okay... I'll buy that. It sounds like something I would do.
So where am I, and what is going on?

setting-out-meeting-captain-braindeath.speaker: Captain Braindeath
setting-out-meeting-captain-braindeath.text: Yer on Braindeath Island!

setting-out-meeting-captain-braindeath.speaker: Captain Braindeath
setting-out-meeting-captain-braindeath.text: Where it lies is a secret, because ye are standin' in the brewery of Cap'n Braindeath, purveyor of the most vitriolic alcoholic beverages in the world!

setting-out-meeting-captain-braindeath.speaker: Captain Braindeath
setting-out-meeting-captain-braindeath.text: I am the notorious alchemist Cap'n Braindeath, and this whole operation be my idea!

setting-out-meeting-captain-braindeath.speaker: Captain Braindeath
setting-out-meeting-captain-braindeath.text: With my crew of sturdy, upright pirate brewers, we sail the seven seas, distributing cheap 'alcohol' to all and sundry.

setting-out-meeting-captain-braindeath.speaker: Captain Braindeath
setting-out-meeting-captain-braindeath.text: These be dark times, though, [lad/lass]. See, a week ago we awoke to find ourselves beseiged.

setting-out-meeting-captain-braindeath.speaker: Captain Braindeath
setting-out-meeting-captain-braindeath.text: The lads and I have held them off so far, but 'tis only a matter of time before they sweep through the buildin' and put us all to the sword.

setting-out-meeting-captain-braindeath.speaker: Captain Braindeath
setting-out-meeting-captain-braindeath.text: Them!
Cutscene begins
The captian points out of the window....
Cutscene ends

setting-out-meeting-captain-braindeath.speaker: Captain Braindeath
setting-out-meeting-captain-braindeath.text: Arr, [lad/lass]! That they are!

setting-out-meeting-captain-braindeath.speaker: Captain Braindeath
setting-out-meeting-captain-braindeath.text: Day and night they seek to break our will with their chantin', and their singin' and their passive resistance!

setting-out-meeting-captain-braindeath.player: So, what do you want me to do?

setting-out-meeting-captain-braindeath.speaker: Captain Braindeath
setting-out-meeting-captain-braindeath.text: Well, me and the lads got our heads together and decided that if we can get their Cap'n drunk enough, perhaps they'll stop protestin'.

setting-out-meeting-captain-braindeath.speaker: Captain Braindeath
setting-out-meeting-captain-braindeath.text: If that happens, we'll slip out the back and set up shop somewhere else.

setting-out-meeting-captain-braindeath.speaker: Captain Braindeath
setting-out-meeting-captain-braindeath.text: Well, first of all, we need someone to go out the front and grow us some Blindweed.

setting-out-meeting-captain-braindeath.speaker: Captain Braindeath
setting-out-meeting-captain-braindeath.text: 'Tis one of the ingredients of our 'rum'.

setting-out-meeting-captain-braindeath.speaker: Captain Braindeath
setting-out-meeting-captain-braindeath.text: The only problem is that those rottin' fiends have torn up and destroyed all but one of the Blindweed Patches.

setting-out-meeting-captain-braindeath.speaker: Captain Braindeath
setting-out-meeting-captain-braindeath.text: Here, [lad/lass]. I'll give ye the seed you'll need fer growin' the herb. Help yerself to the gardenin' equipment in the basement.

setting-out-meeting-captain-braindeath.speaker: Captain Braindeath
setting-out-meeting-captain-braindeath.text: I'll warn ye again that those devils are sat right on top of the patch.

setting-out-meeting-captain-braindeath.speaker: Captain Braindeath
setting-out-meeting-captain-braindeath.text: Try hecklin' 'em from a distance. Those Swabs may talk a good fight, but if ye can put a scare in 'em they'll keep out of yer way!

options.text: What exactly do you want me to do?

steps.player: What exactly do you want me to do?

steps.speaker: Captain Braindeath
steps.text: Arr, well I want ye to get outside and grow some Blindweed.

steps.speaker: Captain Braindeath
steps.text: Best be careful, [lad/lass], fer them pirates will skin ye alive if they catch ye.
If the player has lost the Blindweed seed:

steps.player: And what happens if I lose the seed?

steps.speaker: Captain Braindeath
steps.text: Then I'll have ye flogged, hung, slapped with a haddock and sent back out there to fight the zombie hordes with little more than harsh language!
If the player has no inventory space:

steps.speaker: Captain Braindeath
steps.text: Come back and see me when ye ain't loaded down with stuff, and I'll give ye another.
If the player has inventory space:

steps.speaker: Captain Braindeath
steps.text: Arr... Here, [lad/lass]. Just take this and get goin'!
(The player is handed another seed.)

options.text: Why do you talk like a pirate?

steps.player: Why do you talk like a pirate? Didn't you tell me you were an alchemist?

steps.speaker: Captain Braindeath
steps.text: Arr, [lad/lass], 'tis true.

steps.speaker: Captain Braindeath
steps.text: However, 'tis also true that I stumbled across the basic recipe fer my most potent of brews in a terrible alchemical accident.

steps.speaker: Captain Braindeath
steps.text: See, 'twas a dark and stormy night, and the wind was howlin' around the trees as I worked late into the night.

steps.speaker: Captain Braindeath
steps.text: Steppin' too close to a candle with my flask in my hand, I was suddenly swept up in a terrible, yet potently alcoholic, explosion.

steps.player: And?

steps.speaker: Captain Braindeath
steps.text: Well' [lad/lass], it seems the fumes from that first batch of me 'rum' did strange things to me brain.

steps.speaker: Captain Braindeath
steps.text: I don't remember the exact words the healers used, but apparently the stuff burned out the tiny, specialised part of me brain that tells me not to talk like a pirate.

steps.player: That... that... that sounds utterly impossible!

steps.speaker: Captain Braindeath
steps.text: Arr! That be what I told them!

options.text: So what do you make here anyway?

steps.player: So what do you make here anyway?

steps.speaker: Captain Braindeath
steps.text: 'Rum', [lad/lass]!

steps.speaker: Captain Braindeath
steps.text: The finest, most potent, most flammable and most debilitatin' 'rum' in the whole of Gielinor!

steps.player: Rum, eh?

steps.speaker: Captain Braindeath
steps.text: No, [lad/lass], 'rum'!

steps.player: What's the difference?

steps.speaker: Captain Braindeath
steps.text: Well, see, it's like this.

steps.speaker: Captain Braindeath
steps.text: If we called the stuff we make 'rum' without makin' the little quote gestures every time, then the Cookin' Guild has promised to do entertaininly painful things to us with whisks.

steps.speaker: Captain Braindeath
steps.text: See, technically -

steps.speaker: Captain Braindeath
steps.text: And by that I mean technically according to the Disposal of Hazardous Waste Act and the Health and Safety Laws -

steps.speaker: Captain Braindeath
steps.text: technically, what we're brewin' here is Artificially Produced Hyper Condensed Sweetened 'Rum' Flavour Distillate.

steps.player: Riiiiiiiight...

steps.speaker: Captain Braindeath
steps.text: So ye see, [lad/lass], we just call it 'rum' because the real name be a bit of a mouthful.

steps.speaker: Captain Braindeath
steps.text: Want a drop?

steps.player: No thanks... I think I'll skip it for now.

getting-your-beer-ings-talking-to-davey.speaker: Davey

getting-your-beer-ings-talking-to-davey.speaker: Davey

getting-your-beer-ings-talking-to-davey.speaker: Davey
getting-your-beer-ings-talking-to-davey.text: You are, in fact, what we refer to in layman's terms as a punter.

getting-your-beer-ings-talking-to-davey.speaker: Davey
getting-your-beer-ings-talking-to-davey.text: But anyway, all that priestin' left me with an unshakable faith in three things.

getting-your-beer-ings-talking-to-davey.speaker: Davey

getting-your-beer-ings-talking-to-davey.speaker: Davey

getting-your-beer-ings-talking-to-davey.speaker: Davey

fever-spider-talking-to-captain-braindea.speaker: Captain Braindeath
fever-spider-talking-to-captain-braindea.text: When yer quite done flappin' yer lips, go down into the basement and whack spiders until ye find a fever spider body.

fever-spider-talking-to-captain-braindea.speaker: Captain Braindeath
fever-spider-talking-to-captain-braindea.text: Shove it in the hopper, and then we're in business.

steps.speaker: Captain Braindeath
steps.text: Ye may want to hop back to the mainland and see a Slayer Master.

steps.speaker: Captain Braindeath
steps.text: These Fever Spiders carry a nasty disease, and ye'll need a pair of Slayer Gloves on to not catch it!

steps.speaker: Captain Braindeath
steps.text: I see yer already wearin' some Slayer Gloves. That'll keep the Fever Spiders from gnawin' yer hands off!

options.text: What exactly do you want me to do?

steps.player: What exactly do you want me to do?

steps.speaker: Captain Braindeath
steps.text: I want ye to go kill a Fever Spider and jam its body in the hopper.

steps.speaker: Captain Braindeath
steps.text: Whenever yer ready, [lad/lass].

options.text: Why do you talk like a pirate?
So what do you make here anyway?

fever-spider-using-the-spider-corpse-on-.speaker: Captain Braindeath
fever-spider-using-the-spider-corpse-on-.text: What are ye doin', [lad/lass]? I want ye to shove that in the hopper, not in me face!

fever-spider-using-the-spider-corpse-on-.speaker: Captain Braindeath
fever-spider-using-the-spider-corpse-on-.text: Ye just can't get good help these days...
You cram the diseased Fever Spider body into the hopper.

dissolving-the-protest-talking-to-captai.player: Well, I stuck your spider in the hopper, what now?

dissolving-the-protest-talking-to-captai.speaker: Captain Braindeath
dissolving-the-protest-talking-to-captai.text: Now ye stand well back and watch the glory of brewin' at its best!
The brewing control starts to rumble.

dissolving-the-protest-talking-to-captai.speaker: Captain Braindeath
dissolving-the-protest-talking-to-captai.text: Aye [lad/lass]! Now get outside and feed that stuff to the pirates.

dissolving-the-protest-talking-to-captai.speaker: Captain Braindeath
dissolving-the-protest-talking-to-captai.text: Try givin' it to the Captain, he's in charge. Get him bladdered and the rest will fall!

dissolving-the-protest-talking-to-captai.speaker: Captain Braindeath
dissolving-the-protest-talking-to-captai.text: Ye'll need to use that bucket of yours. Most stuff can't stand bein' in contact with our 'rum' fer too long.

dissolving-the-protest-talking-to-captai.speaker: Captain Braindeath
dissolving-the-protest-talking-to-captai.text: Took us a lot of dissolvin' to work that one out.

dissolving-the-protest-talking-to-captai.speaker: Captain Braindeath
dissolving-the-protest-talking-to-captai.text: So, what did he say?

dissolving-the-protest-talking-to-captai.speaker: Captain Braindeath
dissolving-the-protest-talking-to-captai.text: The Cap'n!

dissolving-the-protest-talking-to-captai.player: Oh! I haven't spoken to him yet!

dissolving-the-protest-talking-to-captai.speaker: Captain Braindeath
dissolving-the-protest-talking-to-captai.text: Well, get a move on!
If the player hasn't gotten 'rum' yet:

steps.speaker: Captain Braindeath
steps.text: And don't ferget the 'rum'!

dissolving-the-protest-turning-the-outpu.text: If the player does not have an empty bucket:

steps.text: Nothing interesting happens.

dissolving-the-protest-turning-the-outpu.text: If the player has an empty bucket:

steps.text: You carefully fill the bucket with the foul-smelling swill.
an unsanitary swill

dissolving-the-protest-talking-to-captai.speaker: Captain Donnie
dissolving-the-protest-talking-to-captai.text: Be that the finest, most abrasive 'rum' I've ever smelled?

dissolving-the-protest-talking-to-captai.speaker: Captain Donnie
dissolving-the-protest-talking-to-captai.text: Hand it over or I'll run ye through!
The Captain drinks the 'rum' as quickly as possible.

dissolving-the-protest-talking-to-captai.speaker: Captain Donnie
dissolving-the-protest-talking-to-captai.text: Arr.

dissolving-the-protest-talking-to-captai.speaker: Captain Donnie
dissolving-the-protest-talking-to-captai.text: Ye be a good [lad/lass], fer a filthy livin' landlubber.

dissolving-the-protest-talking-to-captai.player: So... I take it your boss will be pleased?

dissolving-the-protest-talking-to-captai.speaker: Captain Donnie
dissolving-the-protest-talking-to-captai.text: Arr, that he will. I'll tell...

dissolving-the-protest-talking-to-captai.speaker: Captain Donnie
dissolving-the-protest-talking-to-captai.text: Wait a minute...

dissolving-the-protest-talking-to-captai.speaker: Captain Donnie
dissolving-the-protest-talking-to-captai.text: Arr, ye tricky dog!

dissolving-the-protest-talking-to-captai.speaker: Captain Donnie
dissolving-the-protest-talking-to-captai.text: Ye tried to trick old Donnie!

dissolving-the-protest-talking-to-captai.player: Oh well, I guess I'll have to try again.

dissolving-the-protest-talking-to-captai.speaker: Captain Donnie
dissolving-the-protest-talking-to-captai.text: Arr, [lad/lass], you tried to trick me, but i was too clever for ye!

dissolving-the-protest-talking-to-captai.speaker: Captain Donnie
dissolving-the-protest-talking-to-captai.text: Besides, Rabid Jack would have my hide if I told ye it were him that sent me!

dissolving-the-protest-talking-to-captai.player: I'm sure he would. Good job you caught me out, eh!

dissolving-the-protest-talking-to-captai.speaker: Captain Donnie
dissolving-the-protest-talking-to-captai.text: Aye! Now get ye gone, and don't return without more 'rum'!

dissolving-the-protest-talking-to-captai.speaker: Captain Donnie
dissolving-the-protest-talking-to-captai.text: Hey you! I can smell the 'rum' on ye!

dissolving-the-protest-talking-to-captai.speaker: Captain Donnie
dissolving-the-protest-talking-to-captai.text: If it isn't in my belly by the time I cout ter three, I'll have ye flogged!
Donnie drinks the 'rum' like it is water.

dissolving-the-protest-talking-to-captai.speaker: Captain Donnie
dissolving-the-protest-talking-to-captai.text: Arrr...that hits the spot...
You thankfully have no need to do that any more.

dissolving-the-protest-talking-to-captai.speaker: Captain Braindeath
dissolving-the-protest-talking-to-captai.text: So, what did he say?

dissolving-the-protest-talking-to-captai.speaker: Captain Braindeath
dissolving-the-protest-talking-to-captai.text: Rabid Jack!

dissolving-the-protest-talking-to-captai.speaker: Captain Braindeath
dissolving-the-protest-talking-to-captai.text: THE Rabid Jack!

dissolving-the-protest-talking-to-captai.speaker: Captain Braindeath
dissolving-the-protest-talking-to-captai.text: Egad...I haven't heard that name...

dissolving-the-protest-talking-to-captai.speaker: Captain Braindeath
dissolving-the-protest-talking-to-captai.text: ...before.

dissolving-the-protest-talking-to-captai.speaker: Captain Braindeath
dissolving-the-protest-talking-to-captai.text: Dunno [lad/lass].

dissolving-the-protest-talking-to-captai.speaker: Captain Braindeath
dissolving-the-protest-talking-to-captai.text: Almost as if I aren't changing subjects, well done!

dissolving-the-protest-talking-to-captai.speaker: Captain Braindeath
dissolving-the-protest-talking-to-captai.text: With those rottin' dogs legless they'll never keep fighting us now, so we've decided to stay here and keep the 'rum' flowin!

dissolving-the-protest-talking-to-captai.speaker: Captain Braindeath
dissolving-the-protest-talking-to-captai.text: Thanks, [lad/lass]. We'd never have managed without ye!
Congratulations! Quest complete!

MiztSY.speaker: Captain Braindeath
MiztSY.text: I've got a little put aside fer an emergency. Drop some of that junk yer carryin', and come see me to get it.
